payload.name: list_files
payload.description: List at most 40 entries from your CURRENT workspace, optionally under path_prefix. Omit patch_id for current files; only an actual fixed patch ID selects a published tree. Follow next_cursor with the same path_prefix and patch_id. Editing the current tree invalidates its old cursors. No directory name belongs in patch_id.

patch_id.description: Optional immutable published patch ID copied from fix_patch or observation.all_fixed_patches, for example patch-1. Omit for your CURRENT workspace. It is NOT a directory, object_id, version_id or placeholder. An unknown ID is rejected, never treated as the workspace.

cursor.description: Omit, null or empty string to start the first page. To continue, copy next_cursor exactly from this operation on this source version; editing invalidates it.

path_prefix.description: Optional exact repository-relative file or directory; e.g. tests. Omit for all entries. A trailing slash is allowed; no glob, absolute path or .. .

payload.name: read_file
payload.description: Read up to4096 characters and180 lines of an actual UTF-8 file. Continue exact text with next_cursor; no binary decoding. path must be an exact listed repository-relative file; omit patch_id for current source.

path.description: Optional immutable published patch ID copied from fix_patch or observation.all_fixed_patches, for example patch-1. Omit for your CURRENT workspace. It is NOT a directory, object_id, version_id or placeholder. An unknown ID is rejected, never treated as the workspace.

patch_id.description: Optional immutable published patch ID copied from fix_patch or observation.all_fixed_patches, for example patch-1. Omit for your CURRENT workspace. It is NOT a directory, object_id, version_id or placeholder. An unknown ID is rejected, never treated as the workspace.

cursor.description: Omit, null or empty string to start the first page. To continue, copy next_cursor exactly from this operation on this source version; editing invalidates it.

payload.name: search_file
payload.description: Search one UTF-8 file literally; at most20 matches with bounded previews. Continue with next_cursor.

cursor.description: Omit, null or empty string to start the first page. To continue, copy next_cursor exactly from this operation on this source version; editing invalidates it.

payload.name: replace_file
payload.description: Replace exactly one nonempty literal occurrence in the current UTF-8 file. No regex or fuzzy matching. If zero matches, read current text; if multiple, include exact surrounding text to make old unique. A rejection performs no edit.

payload.name: write_file
payload.description: Replace an existing writable UTF-8 file completely within the frozen source policy; records a new version.

payload.name: diff_workspace
payload.description: Read up to4096 characters of your current workspace's cumulative diff against the frozen baseline. Continue with next_cursor; editing invalidates it. Binary changes are identified without decoding.

cursor.description: Omit, null or empty string to start the first page. To continue, copy next_cursor exactly from this operation on this source version; editing invalidates it.

payload.name: claim_task
payload.description: Accept an unassigned task, or explicitly take over a retired owner's task with a reason. Responsibility does not restrict file editing.

payload.name: declare_dependency
payload.description: Declare an acyclic task dependency. Fixing the dependent patch requires the upstream patch in this tree, or both tasks in the same patch. Binds the prerequisite's current task revision; remove and redeclare to adopt revised scope.

payload.name: fix_patch
payload.description: Publish your actual changed files as an immutable cumulative patch. task_ids=[] explicitly records no task binding, so direct work needs no task-board ceremony; any named tasks must be owned by you and satisfy declared exact-revision dependencies. Publishing is not testing or acceptance.

payload.name: integrate_patch
payload.description: Three-way merge a published patch into your copy. Real conflicts write conflict markers for you to repair; no automatic resolution or tests.

payload.name: run_tests
payload.description: run_tests() preserves the frozen public full-suite entrypoint. For focused tests, pass selection with kind pytest/django/sympy matching the disclosed frontend. pytest accepts current repository paths or node IDs in targets, plus optional keyword (-k) and markers (-m) boolean filters. Django accepts public dotted test labels in targets. Sympy accepts public test paths and optional keywords as its own -k list. Use only tests found in public code; hidden acceptance tests are unavailable. All selections share the original test/time allowance and record this exact source version; no selection executes a shell.

payload.name: submit_integration
payload.description: Save a fixed submission pending independent acceptance. Requires a real current-version run_tests execution of both public groups and a current fixed patch. Tests need not pass to submit. A saved submission is not a correctness or acceptance result. message is an optional human-readable note; omitting it changes no test, version or submission requirement.

payload.name: return_task
payload.description: Relinquish your task to the shared unassigned board with a reason. Does not assign another member.

payload.name: read_work_event
payload.description: Read one exact published patch event or addressed message/notification by its public sequence. Restores full text omitted from the bounded latest observation. Member-created task and dependency revision events are also public.

payload.name: create_task
payload.description: Create your own unassigned execution task under the root goal or an existing task. No member is assigned until claim_task. At most 24 tasks may be created in an episode.

payload.name: revise_task
payload.description: Revise your owned task, or your own unassigned task, with its current revision and reason. Earlier task text and responsibility remain archived. Root acceptance is immutable.

payload.name: remove_dependency
payload.description: Remove one declared dependency from your owned task, recording why. Previous patches retain their original task/dependency snapshots.

payload.name: read_test_result
payload.description: Read one exact saved page of your own report. Omit cursor for its first page; copy page.next_cursor for continuation. Old reports remain readable after edits but do not prove the current version. Never reruns tests.

cursor.description: Copy page.next_cursor exactly from this saved report, or omit to restart its first page. Do not construct page numbers or reuse another report cursor. No tests run.

payload.name: create_file
payload.description: Create a new writable UTF-8 file; never overwrite a path. Parent directories are implicit.

payload.name: delete_file
payload.description: Delete one existing writable file or link; preserve the immutable prior version.

payload.name: rename_file
payload.description: Move one writable file or link to an absent writable path, including across directories; preserve bytes and metadata.

payload.name: read_task
payload.description: Read the next exact page of the original public problem statement.

cursor.description: Omit, null or empty string to start the first page. To continue, copy next_cursor exactly from this operation on this source version; editing invalidates it.

payload.name: search_repository
payload.description: Search non-overlapping literal occurrences across the permitted current UTF-8 repository. An optional path_prefix selects one file/directory. A page may contain no matches and still have next_cursor: continue until complete. Editing or changing the query invalidates cursors. No shell, symlink following, binary decoding or hidden evaluator access.

cursor.description: Omit, null or empty string to start the first page. To continue, copy next_cursor exactly from this operation on this source version; editing invalidates it.

payload.name: delivery_status
payload.description: Read current-version public-test, fixed-patch and legal-submission evidence plus the next explicit action. This does not run tests, publish, submit, or certify hidden acceptance.

payload.contract: CPU fixture: malformed response then explicit finish.

root_goal.description: CPU fixture: malformed response then explicit finish.

payload.editable_paths_scope: Only the first directory page; use list_files cursor for all entries
payload.source_readonly_policy: Frozen provider checks every mutation, including destinations

action_error_policy.critical_boundaries: Unchanged native/executor identity, reserved runtime fields, actual authorization effects, transport and record integrity

scheduling.done: End current work; no replacement or synthetic event
scheduling.wait: Suspend; no hidden worker creates new work

tool_navigation.source_selection: list_files() lists the current workspace; list_files(path_prefix="tests") lists that directory. Omit patch_id unless inspecting an actual published patch. A failed action changes no source. Use create_file for a new path; replace_file needs one exact nonempty occurrence, including whitespace. Plain assistant text executes nothing: use one declared function, or staff_done(reason) when requesting completion.
